Several sessions (≈8–12 hours, with lots of travelling across the continent)

After passing the Barbarian Test, you help the barbarians of {wiki:Svargrond|Svargrond}: you make friends with the musher {npc:Iskan}, help the shamans of {wiki:Nibelor|Nibelor} against chakoyas and hunters, cure {npc:Nilsor}'s dogs, investigate {wiki:Helheim|Helheim} and uncover the cult of Ghazbaran in the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}. At the end you receive the {wiki:Norseman Outfits|Norseman Outfit} and access to the Formorgar Mines, Helheim, Tyrsung and the dog sleds to Inukaya.

The jarl, Sven the Younger, is not very willing to accept new citizens in the barbarian settlement of Svargrond and so will put you through some trials. If you succeed, you will be able to help the other barbarians who desperately need help.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 130+** (the last mission goes through floors full of {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths} and {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}).
The {spell:Levitate} spell is very useful for reaching the {item:Frostbite Herb}.
Iskan gives you one, but you can buy one
50 gp for each trip with {npc:Buddel}, 100 gp for the {item:Hydra Tongue} and 25 gp for {item:Nilsor's Waterskin}
Rope, shovel and plenty of potions for the Formorgar Mines
Access to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}, {wiki:Helheim|Helheim} and {wiki:Tyrsung|Tyrsung}
Being able to use the dog sleds from {wiki:Nibelor|Nibelor} to {wiki:Inukaya|Inukaya}
Being able to become a citizen of Svargrond and talk to the NPCs of the arena, the boat, etc.
Being able to hand in Frostheart Shards to {npc:Hjaern}
Mission 1 (*Befriending the Musher*): after feeding the Sniffler, {npc:Iskan} takes you to Nibelor ({key:passage}).
Mission *Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism*: from here {npc:Buddel} takes you to Tyrsung (50 gp).
Dog sled from Nibelor to Inukaya
Mission *Nibelor 5: Cure the Dogs*: after handing the 7 ingredients to {npc:Nilsor}.
Always bring {item:Ham} when using the sled.
Mission *The Secret of Helheim*: {npc:Hjaern} gives you permission and {npc:Buddel} takes you to the island (50 gp).
With the quest: you can become a citizen of Svargrond and talk to the arena NPCs, the boat NPCs, etc.
Norseman Outfits Quest (addons with Frostheart Shards)
Mission *Formorgar Mines 4: Retaliation*: {npc:Hjaern} gives you the Norseman Outfit and starts accepting Frostheart Shards.
Inukaya Quest, Sinatuki Quest and Mystery of the Valley Quest
From *Nibelor 5: Cure the Dogs* (access to Nibelor and the sled to Inukaya).
Mission 1: you need access to Nibelor ({npc:Iskan}'s sled).
Mission *Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism* (trip with {npc:Buddel} to Tyrsung).
Mission *The Secret of Helheim* (access to Helheim).
Formorgar Mines Quest, Formorgar Mines Hoist Quest and Lion Trophy Quest
Mission *Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission* (access to the Formorgar Mines).
At least up to the mission *The Contactman* (access to the Formorgar Mines).
The Island of Dragons and The Frozen Trench (The Explorer Society Quest)
Quest done up to the final mission (the Frozen Trench requires at least *Formorgar Mines 3*).
Buy the {item:Spoon} and the {item:Kitchen Knife} from {npc:Chephan} and the {item:Hydra Tongue} from {npc:Rose} on the same trip to Venore.
{npc:Buddel} is drunk: sometimes he takes you to the wrong island. When he asks you for a {item:Dwarven Ring} for the trip, say {key:no} and he accepts 50 gp instead.
To go back from Nibelor to Svargrond say {key:passage} to {npc:Nilsor}. To go to Nibelor, ask {npc:Iskan} for {key:passage} (after the first mission).
In the dog mission there is a **5-minute** wait between uses of the spoon, the knife and the waterskin. If you use it too early you get "You might try again later."
The {item:Frostbite Herb} can only be cut at **night** and the {item:Purple Kiss Blossom} only by **day** (Tibia time).
1. Befriending the Musher — the dog Sniffler

If you are not in **Svargrond** yet, take a boat there (for example in Carlin or with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais): talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city. {npc:Iskan} is on the ice to the **north** of the city.

After completing the Barbarian Test, go to the north-east of **Svargrond** and talk to {npc:Iskan}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. One of the dogs ran away; Iskan gives you a piece of {item:Meat} to feed it.
Go **south** of where you found the mammoth in the Barbarian Test and look for {npc:A Starving Dog}. Say {key:Sniffler} and then {key:meat}. If **green sparks** appear over it, it went well.
Go back to {npc:Iskan}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. From now on you can ask him for {key:passage} to go to the island of {wiki:Nibelor|Nibelor}.
Bring the {item:Pick}. Ask {npc:Iskan} for {key:passage} to go to {wiki:Nibelor|Nibelor}. There, go **north** to a cave and talk to the shaman {npc:Hjaern}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}.
Hjaern (cave in the north of Nibelor)
Break the three cracks in the ice

Go **east**, next to the large crack that runs north to south at the easternmost tip of Nibelor. Use the {item:Pick} on the **three small cracks** shown. Every time you use the pick, several {wiki:Chakoyas|Chakoyas} appear.
Yellow dot with black outline = crack in the ice
Once broken, a crack can only be used again when it closes (about 5 minutes).
Go back to {npc:Hjaern}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He tells you to talk to Siflind.

Go up the ramp next to {npc:Hjaern} and talk to {npc:Siflind}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. She gives you a {item:Jug (Ants)|Jug} to collect ants in Tiquanda. From here on {npc:Buddel} can take you to Tyrsung.
If you lose the jug, you can buy another from Siflind for 1000 gp.

To return to Svargrond, talk to {npc:Nilsor}, **west** of the Nibelor stone circle, and ask for {key:passage}. In Svargrond, take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:thais} or {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and from there another boat to **Port Hope**.

Travel to **Port Hope** and go to near the {wiki:Dworcs|dworcs} spawn, south of the city, in {wiki:Tiquanda|Tiquanda}. Use the {item:Jug (Ants)|Jug} on an {item:Ant-Hill}. There is one at this spot. Then walk back **north** to Port Hope and take boats back to Svargrond (via Thais, Carlin or Venore).
The Ant-Hill where you use the jug
Go back to Svargrond and talk to {npc:Buddel}, the drunk sailor in the **south** of the city. Ask to go to {key:Tyrsung}. When he asks for a {item:Dwarven Ring}, say {key:no} and pay 50 gp.
Where Buddel drops you off in Tyrsung
Because he is drunk, Buddel may take you to the wrong island. If you say yes to the ring request, you lose your Dwarven Ring.

In Tyrsung go to the **south** coast, where there is a hunters' outpost full of outlaws and a few {creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders}. Enter the ship (inside there is a {creature:Pirate Cutthroat} and 3 {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}) and go down to the lower deck, where there are 2 {creature:Pirate Buccaneer|Pirate Buccaneers} and 4 Smugglers.
Location of the hunters' ship in Tyrsung
Release the ants on the mast
On the lower deck, use the {item:Jug (Ants)|Jug} on the **west mast**.
The west mast on the ship's lower deck

Go up from the lower deck, leave the ship and head back along the coast to where Buddel dropped you off. To return, tell {npc:Buddel} {key:hi} and {key:svargrond}; when he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay 50 gp (if he drops you on the wrong island, ask again). From Svargrond, ask {npc:Iskan} for {key:passage} to return to Nibelor.
Go back to Nibelor and tell {npc:Siflind}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}.
Ask {npc:Siflind} for another mission: {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Vial of Paint} to spoil the baby seals' fur.

Go back to Tyrsung with {npc:Buddel} and follow the coast **south** from the boat. There are several {item:Baby Seal (Object)|Baby Seals} along the coast. Use the {item:Vial of Paint} on **three** of them. When you look at a painted seal you see "It is covered with paint." To return, go back to where Buddel dropped you off and tell {npc:Buddel} {key:hi} and {key:svargrond}; when he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay 50 gp (if he drops you on the wrong island, ask again); then go to Nibelor with {npc:Iskan} ({key:passage}).
Where the baby seals are in Tyrsung
You can paint just one seal and wait about 30 seconds for the paint to fade, so you can paint it two more times.

Ask {npc:Siflind} for {key:mission}. She asks for the ingredients one at a time: hand over each batch by saying {key:mission} and {key:yes}, in the order of the table. At the end she tells you to talk to {npc:Nilsor}.

{npc:Nilsor} (the NPC who takes you back to Svargrond) needs 7 rare ingredients to cure the dogs. Hand them over one by one, saying the name of the ingredient and {key:yes}. Remember the 5-minute wait between uses of the spoon, knife and waterskin.
{item:Kitchen Knife} on a {item:Purple Kiss Bush} (by day)
Hydra Tongue, Spoon and Kitchen Knife (Venore)

In **Venore**, go to {npc:Rose}'s botany shop, a little **south-east** of the boat, and buy a {item:Hydra Tongue} (say {key:hydra tongue}) for 100 gp. In the shop furthest **west** in Venore buy a {item:Spoon} and a {item:Kitchen Knife} from {npc:Chephan}.
Buy the {item:Nilsor's Waterskin} from {npc:Nilsor} for 25 gp.

Use the waterskin on an {item:Inactive Geyser} (never an active one: the water is too hot). Closer option: in the **Nibelor Ice Cave**, at this spot (watch out for the {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems}). The cave has two entrances, two holes in the **south** of Nibelor; to leave, go up the same hole with the {item:Rope}.
Other entrance of the Nibelor Ice Cave (hole)
Inactive Geyser where you fill the waterskin

Alternative: ask {npc:Buddel} to go to {key:Okolnir} (50 gp, say no to the Dwarven Ring). When you step off, walk 10 steps south and you see the geysers on the right: use the waterskin on the **middle** one while it is not spouting water. Or, when you disembark, go straight **east** around the mountain (not south, where the dragons are) to a dead end with an Inactive Geyser. To return from Okolnir, tell {npc:Buddel} {key:hi} and {key:svargrond}; when he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay 50 gp (if he drops you on the wrong island, ask again).

The easiest way: go to this spot and use {spell:Levitate} to go up **three times**. Then go **west** and use Levitate to go down at the second spot. The {item:Frostbite Herb} is on your **left**: use the {item:Kitchen Knife} on it. Along the way you only meet one {creature:Ice Golem}. To return, do the same path in reverse: go up with {spell:Levitate} where you went down and go down with Levitate to the starting point.
The Frostbite Herb at the top of the mountain
The herb can only be cut at **night** (Tibia time).

Alternative: on top of the **Tyrsung** mountain, at {coord:32358,31243,3} (watch out for {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants} and {creature:Frost Giantess|Frost Giantesses}). Another: just south of the mammoth in the Barbarian Test, levitate up 3x, follow the right-hand wall to a ramp (several Ice Golems), turn left straight away and south, go up the ramp and go to the end of the path.

Use the {item:Spoon} on an {item:Lava Hole (Inactive)|inactive lava hole}. There is one in {wiki:Goroma|Goroma}, at this spot: you can only get there with {npc:Jack Fate} in Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes}; 500 gp, after the mission *Access to Goroma* of The Shattered Isles Quest), and you return with him from the east of Goroma. The simplest option is the tunnel between Thais and Fibula: it is the first one you see when going down the stairs (the entrance is south-west of Thais; to leave go up the same stairs). There are also some in the {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} spawn of the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, in the {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls|Maze of Lost Souls} and in {wiki:Cyclopolis|Cyclopolis} (south, first floor).
Jack Fate in the east of Goroma (back to Liberty Bay)
From level 30 you can enter a {item:Fire Archway} in any city: the {wiki:Fire Shrine|Fire Shrines} areas you are taken to also have inactive lava holes.

In **Ankrahmun**, go **east** of the boat and find the {item:Sun Adorer Cactus} (recognisable by its red flower). Use the {item:Kitchen Knife} on it to get a {item:Piece of Cactus}. You only need one.
Cactus west of the north gate
The Sun Adorer Cactus with the red flower

In **Port Hope**, go to {wiki:Trapwood|Trapwood}, next to the river that splits the city into north and south. Stay on the **south** side and follow the river **east** to a huge mushroom, the {item:Giant Glimmer Cap Mushroom}. Use the {item:Spoon} on it to collect the spores.
The Giant Glimmer Cap Mushroom in Trapwood
Right next to the mushroom there are several {item:Purple Kiss Bush|Purple Kiss Bushes}. Use the {item:Kitchen Knife} on one of them to pick the {item:Purple Kiss Blossom}.
Purple Kiss Bush near the mushroom
It can only be picked during the **day** (Tibia time).

Go back to {npc:Nilsor} and hand over each ingredient by saying its name (see the table above) and {key:yes}. When you have handed over all 7, say {key:mission}. You earn the right to use the dog sled, to the **east** of him, to {wiki:Inukaya|Inukaya}.
Access to the dog sled to Inukaya
Always bring {item:Ham} when you use the sled: the dogs can feel unwell.
Ask {npc:Hjaern} for {key:mission} and accept with {key:yes}. He gives you permission to go to the island of {wiki:Helheim|Helheim}.
Talk to {npc:Buddel} in Svargrond and ask to go to {key:Helheim} (say {key:no} to the Dwarven Ring and pay 50 gp).
Where Buddel drops you off in Helheim

In Helheim go up the stairs to the **south-east** and go down the hole (there are {creature:Mummy|Mummies} and {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}). Go to the **south** end and go down the stairs. Go **west** to another staircase and go down. Head **south-east** and go down. Head **west** and go down the stairs. Then go to the **north** end, to a small house.
Enter the house, run past (or kill) the {creature:Elder Bonelord} and the {creature:Braindeath} and approach the skeleton.
The altar with the skeleton in Helheim

Go back the same way: go up the four stairs you came down and go up the hole at the start with the {item:Rope}. Then go down the south-east stairs to Buddel and tell {npc:Buddel} {key:hi} and {key:svargrond}; when he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay 50 gp (if he drops you on the wrong island, ask again). From Svargrond, go to Nibelor with {npc:Iskan} ({key:passage}).
Go back to {npc:Hjaern}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He asks you for one more favour: say {key:yes}. Now you have to talk to {npc:Lurik}.
Leave Nibelor and go to the {wiki:Explorer's Society|Explorer's Society} in Svargrond. Talk to {npc:Lurik}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.

Talk to {npc:Buddel} and ask to go to the {key:camp} (raiders' camp, in the {wiki:Raider Camp|Barbarian Settlements}, south-west of Svargrond). You can also go on foot: leave Svargrond to the **west** and cross the glacier and a small bridge.
Where Buddel drops you off (Barbarian Settlements)
In the camp, go to the **south** end, where there are many barbarians. Near the southernmost coast look for {npc:Nor} and ask him for the {key:memory crystal}.
Location of Nor in the raiders' camp

Go back to where Buddel dropped you off and tell {npc:Buddel} {key:hi} and {key:svargrond}; when he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay 50 gp (if he drops you on the wrong island, ask again) (or walk back **east** over the bridge and the glacier). In Svargrond, talk to {npc:Lurik}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. Then **wait 5 minutes** and ask for {key:mission} again.
After 5 minutes, say {key:mission} to {npc:Lurik}. He wants you to investigate the old mines.

Leave **Svargrond** to the **west**, use {spell:Levitate} to go up and follow the route in the image to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}; at the end of the path go down the stairs to enter the mines. Get ready for many {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices of the Cult}, some {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes} and {creature:Adept of the Cult|Adepts of the Cult}, {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles}.
Numbered route from Svargrond to the Formorgar Mines
First floor of the mines: the yellow circle is the exit ramp; the pink circles are the stairs to floor 2

Shortcut to point 5 of the route: go up to the glacier and go down a hole at {coord:32105,31115,5}, but that room has 2 {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}, 3 {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders} and other creatures. Alternative: the Ice Portal in Thais ({wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest|Forgotten Knowledge Quest}) drops you near point 11 of the image.
Inside the mines follow the path in the image to the ghost {npc:A Restless Soul}.
Path inside the mines to A Restless Soul

Open the skeleton just to the **north** of the ghost. You find an old paper signed *"Tylaf, apprentice of Hjaern"*. With this, mission 1 is done (it does not show as complete in the Quest Log yet, but you can already go back to Svargrond).

There is no quick exit: go back the same way to the first floor and go up the exit ramp (yellow circle on the first-floor map). Outside, retrace the route to **Svargrond**; use {spell:Levitate} to go down where you went up. To go to Hjaern, ask {npc:Iskan} for {key:passage}.
First floor: the yellow circle marks the ramp out of the mines
10. Formorgar Mines 2 and 3: Ghostwhisperer / The Secret
Go back to {npc:Hjaern} and say {key:hi}, {key:Tylaf}. He gives you the ability to talk to ghosts.

Go back to the Formorgar Mines by the same route and talk to {npc:A Restless Soul}: {key:hi}, {key:story}. He tells you that Ghazbaran's cultists tortured him and want to melt the ice of the Formorgar Glacier to release an army of demons. Then leave the mines as the first time (first-floor ramp) and go back to Svargrond.
Go back to {npc:Hjaern}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He gives you the {item:Frost Charm} to mark four obelisks in the mines.

You have to mark four {item:Blue Shrine Stone|Blue Shrine Stones} (obelisks) with the {item:Frost Charm}. They are all on the same floor, deep in the mines, and the way is full of very dangerous creatures.
Go down to the second floor of the mines

Follow the same route as in the previous missions (points 1 to 10 of the route). On the mines' **second floor**, instead of taking the east passage to the ghost, take the **north** passage to the end and follow it **east** to the ramp that goes down one floor.
Path inside the mines to the obelisks floor
Follow the passage **west** and enter the **second** passage to the **south**. Follow it to the **second** passage to the **west**: at the entrance you see another ramp. Go down.

On this floor there are {creature:Enlightened of the Cult|Enlightened of the Cult}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}.
Walk a few steps **north** and follow the passage **west** to the next passage **north**. Keep going north and, at the fork, take the **right** passage. You find a skeleton: open it.
Go down to the obelisks floor
Go down the ramp **twice** (there are some Nightmares and Destroyers). This is the obelisks floor.

It is the most dangerous floor of the quest: {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}, {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls}, {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}. Go well supplied.
Always walk close to the walls and slowly, to avoid mass attacks from the monsters.
Use the {item:Frost Charm} on each of the four {item:Blue Shrine Stone|Blue Shrine Stones}. Three are in a diagonal line to the **north-east** and the fourth is towards the **north-west** corner.
Yellow dots with black outline = obelisks to mark

Go back the same way, floor by floor: go up the ramps you came down to the second floor and then to the first, and leave by the exit ramp (yellow circle on the first-floor map). Outside, retrace the route to **Svargrond** (go down with {spell:Levitate} where you went up) and ask {npc:Iskan} for {key:passage} to go to Hjaern.
First floor: the yellow circle marks the ramp out of the mines
The way back goes through the same dangerous floors: do not leave without enough potions.
Go back to {npc:Hjaern}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. You receive the **Norseman Outfit** and can now hand in Frostheart Shards.
It is also known as Svargrond Quest, Snow Quest or Nordic Shaman Quest.
Do not confuse it with the {wiki:Alawar's Vault Quest|Alawar's Vault Quest} (Senja).
Lurik tells you an old trick from the Carlin mining company for opening doors in the mines, but he whispers it (<whisper>).
